domain.title: Grooming Product Architecture
domain.outcome: Select product formats by function and use case before matching brand products.
coverageGaps: Acquire authoritative primary evidence and qualified review; topic enumeration is not expertise.

modules.title: Grooming Product Architecture — Foundation
modules.assessment: Define core terms, distinguish commonly confused concepts, and identify scope boundaries in a case.
modules.completionGate: All topic dossiers reviewed; domain specialist accepts the assessment; no unresolved safety-critical contradictions.

modules.title: Grooming Product Architecture — Mastery
modules.assessment: Explain two practical options, ask for missing context, and justify tradeoffs with reviewed sources.
modules.completionGate: All topic dossiers reviewed; domain specialist accepts the assessment; no unresolved safety-critical contradictions.

modules.title: Grooming Product Architecture — Advanced
modules.assessment: Critique methods, applicability, conflicting findings and implementation constraints in a sourced dossier.
modules.completionGate: All topic dossiers reviewed; domain specialist accepts the assessment; no unresolved safety-critical contradictions.

modules.title: Grooming Product Architecture — Frontier
modules.assessment: Produce an evidence gap map separating mechanism, preclinical findings, human outcomes and marketing; no automatic recommendation.
modules.completionGate: All topic dossiers reviewed; domain specialist accepts the assessment; no unresolved safety-critical contradictions.
